title: The fight over Austin's own power company
subtitle: How a 2002 opt-out became a 2026 campaign proposal
alt: Timeline of the fight over city-owned electric utilities in Texas: in 2002 the state deregulated its power market and Austin and San Antonio opted out; a February 2023 ice storm cut power to hundreds of thousands of Central Texas customers; in 2023 state Rep. Ellen Troxclair filed a bill to make public utilities offer retail shopping and it died in committee; in May 2026 a Texas Senate committee examined utility payments to city budgets; on Aug. 3, 2026 Gov. Greg Abbott proposed legislation ending city utility monopolies; and on Sept. 8, 2026 Austin and San Antonio said the change would raise rates
